hands.unsupported: dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 replaces its tool surface only through a profile plugin (presentAs/restrict/guard/register on the scoped tools service); no CLI flag disables its shell and file tools or adds an MCP server, so the one boxed tool cannot be expressed without a plugin. Re-measured on 0.1.2-rc.1 (2026-09-04): the launcher and headless flags are unchanged; the tools plugin reads a DSH_TOOLS_MODE environment value whose vocabulary the release does not document, so it is not relied on. The plugin is the next slice.
